role: Real markup-vs-margin math — genuinely, commonly confused in business practice. Markup is calculated against cost, margin against price; verified directly that a 40% markup only nets a 28.6% margin, not 40%.
behaviorDescription: recommendPrice() computes the real price needed to hit an actual target margin via priceForTargetMargin(), verified against a real case before implementation. computeMarkupAndMargin() reports both real numbers so the two are never conflated.
hardStops: Never conflates markup and margin — they are always reported as two distinct real numbers
